 My Pretty
Get bronze medals on all the levels of all the songs from Volume 1

 My Shiny
Get silver medals on all the levels of all the songs from Volume 1

Get a bronze medal and nothing more on any song (OST only)

 Silver Bullet
Get a silver medal and nothing more on any song (OST only)

notes.title: Ragnarock: Vikings on Tour update available soon
notes.notes:
Ahoy vikings,

Since you guys made Ragnarock such a big success, we decided to explore ways for non-VR players to experience the fun as well. We are very happy to announce that an update will be available soon to adapt the game for PC. No need for a VR setup anymore, it’s time you get your friends and family to start playing !


[previewyoutube=erNtv98_tYk;full][/previewyoutube]


There will be two ways of playing the PC version of Ragnarock. With a controller or a keyboard, you can either try to control the two hammers or use a “one key one drum” setting which would be a little more accessible for those who are not used to rhythm games. Choose wisely as you will still have to train and improve your skills to be able to play all 3 different difficulty levels of each song and get those gold medals.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/01bfeb8826dc2dadde6cc3b33ad53923468aaccd.png
Go further and win medals


For those new PC players, the 40 free songs from volume 1 and 2 will be included in this new version. And yes, the multiplayer PvP mode will be cross-platform (PC vs VR) !  (For those who may have concerns about the leaderboards, both games will have separate ones.)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/14e7abea7514d06682e97e4d970aad04accf1e17.png
Use your boost to move faster


Oh, one last thing ! 

Since it's a free update for those who already have the PCVR version, anyone who is already playing Ragnarock on SteamVR will automatically get the PC version. On the contrary, future Ragnarock players will get to play on PC or PCVR. 
Will you guys risk your place on the leaderboard and test your skills on this new version of the game ? 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/3791af619c67c6112bbaa81f8f0d604390306c2b.png
The lobby will mostly be the same


Once you start playing this new version do not hesitate to keep us posted about potential ideas, fixes or issues you might have or experience. Our dev team will be available to chat with you on Discord, come say Hey !


Thank you for inspiring us everyday to make Ragnarock a better game.

notes.title: Spring Update (V1.4)
notes.notes:
Hello! For this spring update, we wanted to bring you some love with this update (and a little poem). 

"Spring spring spring! Bringing with it the first rays of Sunshine, its pretty colored flowers, also the return of the beautiful singing birds. 
BUT ABOVE ALL COMING WITH 2 NEW EPIC SONGS FOR RAGNAROCK!!!"

Without any transition, let's see what's in this sunny Patchnote 1.4 : 

2 new songs in Volume 2 :

Memento Mori - Feuerschwanz - Level 2 / 5 / 8 
We are the fire - Warkings - Level 3 / 6 / 8 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/4abe8d8d8064b63862766d6bec343ce6348224ab.png

Features :

New "Advanced Drum Layout" option in "Advanced settings". Activating this checkbox will add a new step in your "Drums and Hammers settings" (on the boat), allowing to move the drums in a more circular shape. 

PLEASE NOTE: Runes will be moved accordingly, meaning two runes on the same beat will not be on one same line, making it harder to read. We recommend using the "Display Beat Lines" from "Gameplay settings" to help with this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/ba48549a6ebdc2efd29c71b0699bddf09b0d0880.png

Change collision method for side shields (more robust to fast movements)
Performance optimization on collisions
Performance and graphic optimization on maps (better LODs and draw distance)
New "Enable LIV" checkbox in "Advanced Settings" (disabled by default). 
PLEASE NOTE: You must activate the checkbox to use LIV for mixed reality capture. By default it is now disabled. For the rest, see guide here.
The render window is now black when LIV is enabled.
Renamed "Eskimo Callboy" into "Electric Callboy"
Updated to UE v4.27 and FMOD v2.02.06
Updated bHaptics SDK
Fix for playing custom songs in multiplayer when they have different names/folders
Fix DLC songs sometimes grey when they should be active in votes in multiplayer
Fix reoccurring crashes


We want to thank you for playing, giving us feedback, and inspiring us to keep improving Ragnarock!

We read your suggestions very carefully so feel free to leave us reviews, or chat with the dev team on our Discord channel!

notes.title: Dance Party Update (V1.2)
notes.notes:
Ahoy captains!

To celebrate the New Year, let's have a Dance Party! Ragnarock's new update contains new songs that will make you move your body, and many more cool features!

Free Songs
To help with our New Year resolutions, let's break a sweat playing these fun new tracks: "Hypa Hypa" by Eskimo Callboy and "Utopia" by The SIDH.

Tutorial
A new tutorial explaining the game mechanics will help you get into the game even more easily.

notes.title: The Ragnarock V1 release is now available!
notes.notes:
Ahoy fellow vikings!

Today is the day! After almost 7 months of Early Access, we’re very happy and proud to release the V1 version of Ragnarock, accompanied by a multitude of additional musical content, a new environment and awesome new features, which will continue to be extended over time.

[previewyoutube=qC5LeAVzDlM;full][/previewyoutube]

What you will find in the Muspelheim update

6 new epic tracks!

Because songs are the heart of this rhythm game, we are happy to announce the arrival of 6 new awesome tracks in addition to the previous 24!

To begin with, we are proud to announce a new collaboration with Alestorm, a pirate metal staple, with the arrival of "No grave but the sea" on the tracklist.

Because there is nothing better than a bit of crazy metal music, Ragnarock players will now be able to smash runes on Kammthaar  and Evier Metal by the ones we don't even introduce anymore: Ultra Vomit!

Saltatio Mortis, who has long been requested by the community, also joins the list of bands participating in Ragnarock. The German folk metal group is therefore arriving with two new tracks: Loki (obviously!) and Löwenherz!

Finally, because everyone loved sweating like never before on “The Great Pirate Bottle” by Sabordage, Ragnarock welcomes a new bespoke track by Sabordage, “Au Petit Matin”, has been added to the list of available songs!

A new environment: travel to Muspelheim!

Since the first environment (Midgard), we've always wanted to add immersive content inspired by Norse mythology. The most observant will have noticed a logic of continuity between the different playable maps, and of course, a correlation between tracks and environments.

Muspelheim thus joins this list of 6 different environments. Muspelheim is the world of fire, kingdom of the giant Surtr... and we wanted to do something awesome!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/8cc0817b0c4cc5bba724058d26a7498799862634.jpg
Muspelheim artwork

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/0c99b26b641ef979f0886a7f0bcb0cadd61f4aae.jpg
Muspelheim artwork

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/9e3458ef48fad64713a36080a972e267be597cb7.png

New features to discover, train, collect and have fun!

Achievements!

Unlock Achievements to get great rewards: new epic and playable hammer pairs will be added to your collection. You can now change hammers using the selector on the right in the tavern. Please note that the differences between hammers are only visual and do not affect gameplay. Collect them all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/118f39a96bdb785fb8c6a7f42707dd5eab68744f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/f23668462c45b2cfd5a9e95c504e67b8fb77bca5.png

A new Practice Mode to become the best!

Check the “Practice Mode” checkbox at the start of a song or in the Pause Menu (in Solo) to choose your speed and the sequence you want to practice! (Please note that when using Practice Mode, medals and high scores are not saved. Ghosts are also not available in Practice Mode.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/691545301b5cce695f6cb9887a9b14e9987a1a34.png

Communicate thanks to emojis!

At the start and end of a multiplayer race, you will find behind you a forge of emojis allowing you to share your emotions with other players in an easy and fun way!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/339db98e3515ad8878cfee074d3008ebcac3791e.png

... and a lot of new fixes and optimization stuff!


 Performance optimization
 Map preference is now also applied in multiplayer games
 Updated stats panel on leaderboards
 Friends Leaderboard now available at the end of a song
 [Fix] Blue combo could not be used right after being acquired
 Lower sound for medals breaking
 Better rounding on hit/miss percentages
 [Fix] Removed invisible buttons in custom song list when less than 3 difficulties present


What happened during Early Access

During these almost seven months of Early Access, Ragnarock has gone through a lot of improvements, heavily influenced by the players’ feedback and needs.


 from 16 to 30 songs
 from 1 to 6 environments
 new design for lobby and UI
 female characters
 new audio system + pause
 a lot of settings (audio, vibrations, advanced, hammer/drums/shields)
 revised scoring system
 multiplayer improvements (vote, join during a race, server list, emojis)
 leaderboards with detailed stats and friends
 multiple ghosts (from leaderboards or friends)
 achievements and collectible hammers
 practice mode


[previewyoutube=oy2pIx3wb0U;full][/previewyoutube]

That's it for today!

As usual, we are still hard at work so stay tuned. You are all invited to share reactions and areas of improvement here, or chat with the dev team on our Discord!

WanadevStudio's social accounts are also great spots to share your feelings with us. You're welcome to follow us on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram!

Vikings, we look forward to seeing you on the sea by our side. See you soon! :beer: 

We want to give a very big thank you to the community that followed us during Early Access, provided feedback, discussed with us on Discord, and helped shape Ragnarock into the game it is today. And welcome to everyone who will join us for the next steps! Get ready for more and more frenzied Viking races on epic rock / metal tracks.

AHOU!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/100edc8c69a3184d733337b6a64326ffa4203a3b.jpg

notes.title: Ragnarock will release on Steam on July 15th!
notes.notes:
Building upon the excellent feedback received from VR players during the last six months of early access for this title, French independent studio WanadevStudio is pleased to confirm the V1 release of Ragnarock VR on July 15th on Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/d3d67032a726ef601bceaff6c5fed1843737b59e.jpg

New content and the highly anticipated Oculus Quest 2 compatibility!

Early access allowed the studio to develop the game while taking into account the community’s feedback. Through regular updates (Alfheim Update, Nidavellir Update, Asgard Update ...), the studio has been committed to expanding the game with the regular addition of music, features, and environments.

The official release of the title will therefore come with a multitude of additional content, with 6 epic new music tracks, a breathtaking new environment, and other amazing features, all of which will continue to be extended over time after the release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/13bbcf6483e306b49c8dd2f7297fb7bd09aca152.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/f1a176215dc8423a3b49fc613ae8b3599bef9b66.jpg

WanadevStudio is also happy to confirm that the game will become available on Oculus Quest 2 during the summer! Stay tuned!

[previewyoutube=2Maubh76ETo;full][/previewyoutube]

96% positive reviews and an Early Access version already rewarded with an award

Since the Early Access version released on Steam in December 2020, it was very well received with 96% positive reviews (title ranked in the highest category, "overwhelmingly positive") out of over a thousand reviews.

For its strong multiplayer component, often lacking from rhythm games, Ragnarock and its innovative racing concept received the prize for Best multiplayer VR game developed by a French studio from the ETR community.


The game will be available on July 15th for a suggested retail price of $24.99 or €21.99 on the Steam platform.

See you (very) soon on the northern seas!

That's it for today! As usual, we are still hard at work so stay tuned. You are all invited to share reactions and areas of improvement here, or chat with the dev team on our Discord!

WanadevStudio's social accounts are also great spots to share your feelings with us. You're welcome to follow us on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram!

Vikings, we look forward to seeing you on the sea by our side. Race you soon! :beer:

notes.title: The Asgard Update (#9)
notes.notes:
Ahoy captains!

We just released an update! Thanks to everyone who gave us feedback, and as always we want to give a very warm thank you to our reactive community and especially to our beta-testers for their time and help! Here's what you will find in this update:


 Asgard, an Epic New Journey 
Hold on to your boat, you're about to take off and travel through the skies and onto the Bifrost until you reach the beautiful city of the gods: Asgard! We are very proud to bring you this new environment that will take you on a musical journey into the skies. Tell us in the comments what you think and try to guess which one is next!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/03dc268ad10f9fcbb1fbf421226fba02b946fa8d.jpg

 3 New Songs 
Masters of the Galaxy by Gloryhammer (level 3/5/9), Tortuga by Alestorm (level 3/5/7) and Welcome to Asgard by Manaberry (level 1/3/6), an original creation for Ragnaröck. Here are some more amazing songs to bang your drums to! Rest assured that we are working hard in order to keep adding more in the upcoming months.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/ed5a8e01c83677cbc2bc33dc2198df2a9ce61a2b.jpg

 Improved Leaderboards
- Display detailed stats of high scores when hovering the Leaderboard (in lobby)
- Additional Leaderboard with Steam friends only (in lobby)
- Blue and yellow combos counted separately on score panel and in stats
Please note to support these new features (and the new ghosts), Leaderboards, high scores and medals have been reset.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/50124810683669ea099a173cda26182377868e8c.jpg

 More Ghost Options
Five more ghosts are now available in solo (on top of your Personal best) on each song/level:
- Song Top #1 (from global leaderboard)
- Player ranked 10 places above you (from global leaderboard)
- Player ranked 5 places above you (from global leaderboard)
- Top #1 amongst your friends (from Friends leaderboard)
- Friend ranked above you (from Friends leaderboard)
You can choose which ghosts are activated and against which one your distance is compared (panel at the front of your boat) in the Ghost settings. Get ready for solo races with up to 6 real adversaries!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/2af2871bab4d9d4f79258a7a8f85eba4243798d2.jpg

 Improved Multiplayer
- [PvP Quickplay] Display list of available servers and their status: number of players, song playing, time remaining
- [PvP Quickplay] Public servers now have a difficulty range (displayed in the list). Songs and votes can only be chosen in this range.
- [PvP Quickplay] You can create a new server with your own difficulty range and choose the first song. You can play alone on a server while waiting for other players.
- [PvP Quickplay AND Private] Join the race mid-song even if it has already started (good luck catching up to the others!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/e4cac43087f03a987a7297fb5aa92cadefce5893.jpg

 Improved Quick Menu (during a song)
- In solo, opening the menu pauses the game (you can't pause a PvP race of course)
- Drums and hammers settings are now available in the Quick menu
- On Oculus headsets, you must now press the Menu button on the left controller to open the Quick menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/9512e34db4208882df798241f7c0ddfed097535a.jpg

 New Sound Engine
Better audio synchronization, using the fmod sound engine. This is intended to solve the sync problems between music and rune hits that some players told us about (and for which they used the latency setting to compensate). It also allows us to add cool new features now and in the future (like Pause).
Please note your previous latency settings are now obsolete. We advise you to reset the latency to zero before playing (see Advanced settings).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/345c8226156ebfc73e4cc12c6bb643f57e0094fd.png

 New “Advanced” Settings
- moved “Latency” setting there
- new setting to show latency in your score panel (disabled by default)
- new setting to adjust the “Drum sound compensation” (0% : Play the drum sound exactly when you hit (more accurate), 100% : Play the drum sound exactly on the beat (more ear-pleasing), Default: 70%)
- Setting “Skip intro” to bypass the logo/splash screens on startup
- Setting “Hide hands” to remove hand models on your hammers during game

- “Viewer cameras” can now be activated and chosen from this menu (multiple viewpoints available). This feature allows you to display external camera views on your monitor, independently from your VR view. It can be used to :

Provide a more comfortable viewing experience for spectators, either on your couch or during livestreams
Create entertaining gameplay videos with multiple camera angles and movements
Record yourself playing from a different point of view to improve your technique or give us specific feedback

Warning : Please note this feature may cause performance issues. If you had already activated external cameras using the Steam guide (now updated), please note your camera settings will be reset and you must activate them again through the in-game settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/18def3f07e5b327ee3450459838d32983da4e4c7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/67e755d7143019975fc383ff752dae153f2d0fef.jpg

 New “Empty” environment: Just the sea and you, nothing else in sight. Can be useful for performance issues or motion sickness problems.
 More stable ghost (accurate position, no jumps)
 Smoother end of song (speed decreases but points are still counted until two seconds after the last rune)
 Renamed “Haptics” settings into “Vibrations”
 Clicking on the parchment on the right of the throne displays Game Credits 
 Added a splash screen for fmod credits


That's it for today! As usual, we are still hard at work so stay tuned. You are all invited to share reactions and areas of improvement here, or chat with the dev team on our Discord channel!

WanadevStudio's social accounts are also great spots to share your feelings with us. You're welcome to follow us on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram!

See you soon for more news on Ragnarock ! :beer:

notes.title: New update available for Ragnaröck #2
notes.notes:
Update #2: Recenter feature, Audio and latency settings, Display drums/hammers adjustments

How's it going, mighty vikings?

We're still following closely your reviews and feedbacks on Steam and our Discord. Thanks for helping us improve Ragnaröck! A new update is now available with the following changes:

- Option to recenter your position in-game: located after the drums and hammers adjustements (this will snap your drums in front of you wherever your are placed)
- Display drum height and hammer angle values so you can take note and set them back quickly if you move them. We are considering adding different profiles of players later to have multiple settings.
- Fix rank display for in-game leaderboard
- Added "Audio" settings to control sound volume for Master/UI/Track/Voice/Combo/Drums
- Added "Latency" setting to customize music/rune synchronization, located in the "Audio" settings.
- Stabilization of music/rune synchronization

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38879909/b30098c625f8f53edd286ededfcd5f69f8faf0e1.png

Note: If you feel like the synchronization between music and rune is off (if you're using bluetooth headphones for example), use the Latency setting. Our recommendation: check your average latency on your left score panel at the end of each song and enter the opposite value as your latency setting (eg. if your latency average is -10ms, set your latency to 10).

Keep playing and tell us what you think! You are all invited to share reactions and areas of improvement here, or chat with the dev team on our Discord channel!
